author: nickyeow

english.text: It was raining on and off all night long.

jyutping: seng4 maan5 jau6 lok6 haa5 jyu5，jau6 ting4 haa5 jyu5。
text: 成晚又落吓雨，又停吓雨。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We associate the name of Einstein with the theory of relativity.

jyutping: jat1 tai4 dou3 oi3 jan1 si1 taan2，ngo5 dei6 zau6 wui5 nam2 hei2 soeng1 deoi3 leon6。
text: 一提到愛因斯坦，我哋就會諗起相對論。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We live in the neighborhood of the school.
We live close to the school.
We live in the vicinity of the school.
We live near the school.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaan1 hok6 haau6 fu6 gan6 zyu6。
text: 我哋喺間學校附近住。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I have lived here for thirty years.
I've lived here for thirty years.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ni1 dou6 zyu6 zo2 saa1 nin4 laa3。
text: 我喺呢度住咗卅年喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Jill has been on the phone with friends for more than two hours!

jyutping: aa3 Jill ji5 ging1 tung4 keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5 bou1 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 din6 waa2 zuk1 laa3！

english.text: The kite got caught in the tree.

jyutping: zek3 zi2 jiu2 kik1 zo2 hai2 po1 syu6 dou6。
text: 隻紙鷂𠽤咗喺樖樹度。

author: kaenif

english.text: She has a house by the sea.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 hoi2 bin1 jau5 gaan1 uk1。
text: 佢喺海邊有間屋。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Why do people go to the movies?

jyutping: di1 jan4 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 hei3 ge3？
text: 啲人點解要去睇戲嘅？

author: fercheung

english.text: Albania wants to join the European Union.

jyutping: aa3 ji5 baa1 nei4 aa3 soeng2 gaa1 jap6 au1 mang4。
text: 阿爾巴尼亞想加入歐盟。

author: fercheung

english.text: I hope your wish will come true.

jyutping: zuk1 nei5 mei5 mung6 sing4 zan1。
text: 祝你美夢成真。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't keep up with you if you walk so fast.

jyutping: nei5 haang4 dak1 gam3 faai3，ngo5 gan1 m4 dou3 aa3。
text: 你行得咁快，我跟唔到呀。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom knocked on the door to Mary's room.

jyutping: Tom haau1 zo2 Mary fong4 mun4。
text: Tom 敲咗 Mary 房門。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Having met him before, I recognized him at once.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 cin4 gin3 gwo3 keoi5，so2 ji5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 jing6 dak1。
text: 我之前見過佢，所以一眼就認得。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I was searching for something that didn't exist.

jyutping: ngo5 wan2 gan2 jat1 joeng6 m4 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 je5。
text: 我搵緊一樣唔存在嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Since I couldn't pay the rent, I asked him for help.

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 cin4 gaau1 zou1，so2 ji5 zau6 wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2。
text: 我冇錢交租，所以就搵佢幫手。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The raising of children is something that concerns the entire community. There will be an education reform.

jyutping: joeng5 ji4 juk6 neoi5，hai6 se5 wui2 soeng6 haa6 dou1 gwaan1 sam1 ge3 ji5 tai4。ngo5 dei6 wui5 teoi1 hang4 gaau3 juk6 goi2 gaak3。
text: 養兒育女，係社會上下都關心嘅議題。我哋會推行教育改革。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I hope to effect positive change in the world.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 wai6 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 daai2 lai4 zing3 min6 ge3 goi2 bin3。
text: 我想為呢個世界帶嚟正面嘅改變。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Of course they resemble each other in some ways.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 dong1 jin4 jau5 di1 gung6 tung1 dim2。
text: 佢哋當然有啲共通點。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How much do the oranges cost?

jyutping: di1 caang2 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3？
text: 啲橙幾多錢呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Take a nap if you're tired.

jyutping: nei5 gui6 zau6 hap6 jat1 zan6 laa1。
text: 你攰就瞌一陣啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can't the government just print more money?

jyutping: zing3 fu2 jan3 do1 di1 cin4 mai6 dak1 lo1？

english.text: Do you really want to raise these children by yourself?

english.text: Who yelled?

jyutping: bin1 go3 aai3 aa3？

english.text: I think you should help her.

jyutping: nei5 bong1 haa2 keoi5 laa1。

english.text: I think that's too expensive.

jyutping: taai3 gwai3 laa3 ngo5 gok3 dak1。

english.text: Do the Chinese use milk and sugar with their tea?

english.text: The November 1968 issue of the English-language Kingdom Preaching Monthly said, “Because of the great demand for the Truth books, the printing house at the Brooklyn headquarters could not work at night without working overtime just this past September.”

jyutping: jing1 man2 baan2《wong4 gwok3 cyun4 dou6 jyut6 bou3》1968 nin4 11 jyut6 hon2 waa6：「jau4 jyu1《zan1 lei5》syu1 ge3 seoi1 kau4 fei1 soeng4 daai6，hai2 ngaam1 ngaam1 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 9 jyut6，bou3 lou5 hak1 lam4 zung2 bou6 ge3 jan3 caat3 cong2 je6 maan5 m4 gaa1 baan1 dou1 m4 dak1。」
text: 英文版《王國傳道月報》1968年11月刊話：「由於《真理》書嘅需求非常大，喺啱啱過去嘅9月，布魯克林總部嘅印刷廠夜晚唔加班都唔得。」

english.text: A new survey shows that Internet freedom has declined around the world for the fourth consecutive year, as a growing number of countries impose various forms of online censorship and monitoring practices. Rights group Freedom House on Thursday issued an annual report that says more people are being arrested for their Internet activities than ever before, and online media outlets are increasingly pressured to comply with government requests for data or deletions.

jyutping: jat1 hong6 san1 ge3 diu6 caa4 hin2 si6，ceoi4 zyu6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1 gwok3 gaa1 sat6 si1 gok3 zung2 jing4 sik1 ge3 mong5 soeng6 sam2 caa4 tung4 gaam1 hung3 zou6 faat3，cyun4 kau4 wu6 lyun4 mong5 zi6 jau4 dou6 lin4 zuk6 dai6 sei3 nin4 haa6 gong3，ji4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1，jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1 jan4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 zeon3 hang4 sam2 caa4 tung4 gaam1 hung3 jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wu6 lyun4 mong5 wut6 dung6 ji4 bei2 ji5 wong5 jam6 ho4 si4 hau6 dou1 bei6 bou6，ji4 mong5 soeng6 mui4 tai2 jik6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 sau6 dou3 aat3 lik6，jiu3 zeon1 sau2 zing3 fu2 jiu3 kau4 saan1 ceoi4 zi1 liu2。
text: 一項新嘅調查顯示，隨住越嚟越多國家實施各種形式嘅網上審查同監控做法，全球互聯網自由度連續第四年下降，而呢份報告指出，越嚟越多人喺網上進行審查同監控 因為佢哋嘅互聯網活動而比以往任何時候都被捕，而網上媒體亦越嚟越受到壓力，要遵守政府要求刪除資料。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the course of history, many humans have believed that those who did not share their skin color, language, or religion belonged to different "races". The question of which of these factors are relevant in determining the "blood" of an individual is arbitrary and can vary widely depending on the ideology. According to some, "whites" have the same "blood", regardless of language. According to others, those who share the same skin color can have different "bloods" if they speak different languages or belong to different religions. Humans have always tried to find reasons to hate one another, and perhaps will continue to do so until the human race is no more.

jyutping: hai2 lik6 si2 soeng6，hou2 do1 jan4 leoi6 dou1 jing6 wai4 go2 di1 m4 tung4 keoi5 dei6 fu1 sik1、jyu5 jin4 waak6 ze2 zung1 gaau3 ge3 jan4 suk6 jyu1 m4 tung4 ge3「zung2 zuk6」。ni1 di1 jan1 sou3 dong1 zung1 bin1 go3 tung4 kyut3 ding6 go3 jan4 ge3「hyut3」jau5 gwaan1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hai6 jam6 ji3 ge3，ji4 ce2 ho2 ji5 jan1 ji3 sik1 jing4 taai3 ji4 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 caa1 ji6。gan1 geoi3 jat1 di1 jan4 ge3 gong2 faat3，「baak6 jan4」hai6 jau5 soeng1 tung4 ge3「hyut3 tung2」，mou4 leon6 hai6 me1 jyu5 jin4。gan1 geoi3 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 gong2 faat3，go2 di1 tung4 fu1 sik1 ge3 jan4，jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 gong2 m4 tung4 ge3 jyu5 jin4 waak6 ze2 suk6 jyu1 m4 tung4 ge3 zung1 gaau3，zau6 ho2 ji5 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3「hyut3 tung2」。jan4 leoi6 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng4 si3 wan2 lei5 jau4 heoi3 zang1 han6 deoi3 fong1，ji4 ce2 ho2 nang4 wui5 gai3 zuk6 gam3 zou6，zik6 zi3 jan4 leoi6 m4 zoi3 cyun4 zoi6。
text: 喺歷史上，好多人類都認為嗰啲唔同佢哋膚色、語言或者宗教嘅人屬於唔同嘅「種族」。呢啲因素當中邊個同決定個人嘅「血」有關呢個問題係任意嘅，而且可以因意識形態而有好大嘅差異。根據一啲人嘅講法，「白人」係有相同嘅「血統」，無論係咩語言。根據其他人嘅講法，嗰啲同膚色嘅人，如果佢哋講唔同嘅語言或者屬於唔同嘅宗教，就可以有唔同嘅「血統」。人類一直都嘗試搵理由去憎恨對方，而且可能會繼續咁做，直至人類唔再存在。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The blue-streaked cloudy sky is above me, this 5th of July of 2025. This morning was my 64th time this "Krismas" year to the "Clam Temple," the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road on Lulu Island. "64" is numerologically both Jewish and Buddhist. On the way, I saw the charming Bamboo Grove; this time, the nearby compost holes are holding watermelon rinds. Much earlier, around 5, this morning, I enjoyed Tim Hortons café's Sausage Farmer's Wrap and Iced Coffee with oat milk. A few hours later, I had an Earl Grey tea with oat milk. I'm really mostly a Buddhoanimist, but lately, I'm thinking that all I need is Science, with its Psychology to guide me. A Secular spurt? Maybe, Mr. Spock is saying, "Come back to me..." Live long and prosper!

jyutping: laam4 sik1 tiu4 man4 ge3 do1 wan4 tin1 hung1 hai2 ngo5 soeng6 min6，ni1 go3 hai6 2025 nin4 7 jyut6 5 hou6。gam1 ziu1 hai6 ngo5 gam1 go3「sing3 daan3」nin4 dai6 64 ci3 heoi3「gap3 lei4 miu2」，zik1 hai6 wai6 jyu1 lou6 lou6 dou2 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2。 「64」hai2 sou3 zi6 hok6 soeng6 ge3 hai6 jau4 taai3 gaau3，jik6 hai6 fat6 gaau3 ge3。tou4 zung1，ngo5 gin3 dou2 mai4 jan4 ge3 zuk1 lam4；gam1 ci3，fu6 gan6 ge3 deoi1 fei4 dung6 jap6 min6 jau5 sai1 gwaa1 pei4。zou2 zo2 hou2 do1，gam1 ziu1 ng5 dim2 gei2，ngo5 hoeng2 jung6 zo2 Tim Hortons café ge3 hoeng1 coeng2 nung4 fu1 baau1 tung4 maai4 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 bing1 gaa3 fe1。gei2 go3 zung1 zi1 hau6，ngo5 jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 fui1 baak3 zoek3 caa4。ngo5 zan1 hai6 daai6 do1 sou3 dou1 hai6 fat6 gaau3 tou4，daan6 hai6 zeoi3 gan6，ngo5 nam2 gan2 ngo5 so2 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 zi2 hai6 fo1 hok6，tung4 maai4 keoi5 ge3 sam1 lei5 hok6 lai4 jan5 dou6 ngo5。sai3 zuk6 ge3 gik1 zang1？ho2 nang4，si1 bo1 hak1 sin1 saang1 hai6 gam2 gong2：「faan1 lai4 ngo5 dou6 laa3 … … 」coeng4 meng6 baak3 seoi3！
text: 藍色條紋嘅多雲天空喺我上面，呢個係2025年7月5號。今朝係我今個「聖誕」年第64次去「蛤蜊廟」，即係位於露露島聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂。 「64」喺數字學上嘅係猶太教，亦係佛教嘅。途中，我見到迷人嘅竹林；今次，附近嘅堆肥洞入面有西瓜皮。早咗好多，今朝五點幾，我享用咗 Tim Hortons café 嘅香腸農夫包同埋燕麥奶嘅冰咖啡。幾個鐘之後，我飲咗一杯配燕麥奶嘅灰伯爵茶。我真係大多數都係佛教徒，但係最近，我諗緊我所需要嘅只係科學，同埋佢嘅心理學嚟引導我。世俗嘅激增？可能，斯波克先生係噉講：「返嚟我度喇 … … 」長命百歲！
